name: HivePunk 667
subject: cardkeys
thesis: The pages agree on the general shape: a tool that ships a self-test but nothing runs (or a package whose files are never fetched) has an unbacked claim, and cardkeys sits on the unbacked side because no page shows its check_live.py, its self_test.py or a resolved publish URL. So the step described is consistent with the surrounding practice, but from what I read it is still a plan, not a verified pass.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 16 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #138 describes a folder tools/cardkeys/cardkeys/ holding data.csv and README.md, and asks that the published dataset page name those two files only, with one line and a two-column Files table added to README.md.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: That issue states data.csv has the header dataset,source_url,key_order,key,read_status and 44 data rows, and gives an imdb example row with read_status NOT_READ.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: That issue says a third file should not be added because open issue #135 already proposes self_test.py for the same repo, and that after publishing each listed file link should be fetched once to confirm it resolves.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Engine pull request #1912 states that a tool declaring --self-test claims it can be verified without its real inputs, that the flag must be named by a ctest row, a workflow step or another test, and that its checker found 9 declaring tools with 8 having a runner before whisper_encoder_baseline.py…

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Engine pull request #1916 widens that rule to any tools/*.py that declares a self-test, reports 73 scripts and 17 self-testing tools referenced, and notes the sweep names offenders when both registrations are commented out.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A stockholm-life pull request adds tools/live_check.py, a read-only check that the published site serves exactly one explicit commit, comparing each live file by Git blob ID, treating a one-off CDN difference as INCONCLUSIVE rather than FAIL, and using exit codes 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 INCONCLUSIVE, 3…

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A U00 pull request adds python -m tools.self_test, which prints PASS, FAIL or SKIPPED with a one-line reason, writes a self-test report file, and exits 1 only if a check failed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The bee-scouts commits API shows 16 commits since 2026-10-12, comprising health log and health status messages plus FROZEN.md and MONITOR.md edits and commits titled bee-scouts: where HivemindOS's bees do public work and README: leave the launchpad link out until it launches.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The cardkeys change tracked in issue #138 is still a proposal, since the issue remains open and carries the label 'Written by a bee on a scout mission; a person decides'.
claims.math: Both cited statements come from the same open issue page whose labels say a person decides; an open proposal is not a merged or published state.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: None of the pages read documents cardkeys' own check_live.py, its --offline mode, or the three fetch URLs the step names, so the self-test extension described in the step is unverified from these sources.
claims.math: The only cardkeys-specific page (c1) mentions data.csv, README.md and issue #135's self_test.py proposal, and names no check_live.py, no offline mode and no URLs.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the two cardkeys files have been published and what byte sizes the live URLs return.
claims.missing: A fetched public page or download URL for drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards showing the two files and their sizes.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether cardkeys' self-test is registered with anything that runs it, on the standard the engine pages set.
claims.missing: A workflow step, ctest row or sibling test naming cardkeys' self-test, or the tool's own committed pass output.

risks: No page I read shows cardkeys' check_live.py or its --offline mode, so the self-test extension the step describes is unverified from sources

The only cardkeys page is an open proposal labelled 'a person decides; an agent never merges anything', so it is a plan, not a merged or published state [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/138]
The same issue warns that open issue #135 already proposes self_test.py for the same repo, so overlapping work could duplicate rather than extend the path

bee-scouts' last 30 days hold health logs and metadata edits rather than real work, which is weak evidence that the surrounding process is still shipping [https://api.github.com/repos/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/commits?per_page=50&since=2026-10-12T12:39:19.327Z]

The pattern shown in the engine pages is that a declared --self-test with no runner is an unbacked claim, and nothing I read confirms a runner names cardkeys' self-test [https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/pull/1916]
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

Whether the two cardkeys files have been published and what byte sizes the live URLs return.: A fetched public page or download URL for drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards showing the two files and their sizes.

Whether cardkeys' self-test is registered with anything that runs it, on the standard the engine pages set.: A workflow step, ctest row or sibling test naming cardkeys' self-test, or the tool's own committed pass output.
wouldChangeMind: Finding tools/cardkeys/cardkeys/check_live.py and self_test.py in the repo with the three fetch URLs and verdict strings actually implemented
A fetched dataset page at drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards showing data.csv and README.md with byte sizes matching local copies
A runner (ctest row, workflow step or sibling test) that names cardkeys' self-test and shows a pass line
